name: @ludoteca/electron

scripts.dev: tsdown && wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env LUDOTECA_DEV=1 electron .
scripts.package: npm run build -w @ludoteca/core && npm run build -w @ludoteca/ui && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @ludoteca/core && npm run build -w @ludoteca/ui && npm run build && electron-builder

description: One library across Steam, GOG and Epic
